description: This file defines the LeaveCommentAPI class, an API endpoint for managing comments related to leave requests within the OrangeHRM system. It handles listing and creating leave comments, including validation, permission checks, and interaction with the service layer.

classes.name: LeaveCommentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class responsible for listing and creating comments on leave requests, including validation, permission checks, and service interaction.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService that handles data operations related to leave comments.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the leave ID from the request URL parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all comments for a specific leave request, including permission checks and search/filter handling.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' operation, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new comment to a leave request, including validation, permission checks, and saving the comment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new leave comment, primarily validating the comment text.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Provides validation rules common to multiple operations, such as ensuring leave ID is positive.

methods.name: setLeaveComment
methods.description: Populates a LeaveComment entity with comment text, creation timestamp, and creator's details.

methods.name: saveLeaveComment
methods.description: Persists the LeaveComment entity using the related DAO.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented, throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented, throws an exception if called.

methods.name: checkLeaveAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the leave entity based on permissions or self-access, throws ForbiddenException if not.
